allow_mcp_servers.title: Allow Mcp Servers
allow_mcp_servers.description: Permits outbound access to MCP server endpoints configured on the agent, beyond those listed in the `allowed_hosts` array.

allow_package_managers.title: Allow Package Managers
allow_package_managers.description: Permits outbound access to public package registries (PyPI, npm, etc.) beyond those listed in the `allowed_hosts` array.

allowed_hosts.title: Allowed Hosts
allowed_hosts.description: Specifies domains the container can reach.
